title: Malicious code in kartykgithub-bulk-rollback (npm)
description: The npm package 'kartykgithub-bulk-rollback' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a separate, secure device. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by its installation.
